## Overview

Adds an end-to-end CLI test for `vllm bench mm-processor`, which previously had only argument- and dataset-level coverage.

## Claims

- Runs the CLI on `Qwen/Qwen2-VL-2B-Instruct` with dummy weights and 3 random-mm image requests; asserts success, completion, finite per-stage timings, and encoder invocation.
- Runs in the existing "Benchmarks CLI" CI group; no CI or runtime code changes.

## Validation

Covered by the `Benchmarks CLI` group (H200 MIG 18GB). CI result will be linked here once the run completes.

## Details

`--load-format dummy` and `--enforce-eager` keep the run small. Asserting `preprocessor_total_ms` catches stats-output regressions that an exit-code-only test would miss.

---

detail.title: [Test][Multimodal] Add end-to-end CLI test for vllm bench mm-processor

files.patch:
@@ -0,0 +1,82 @@
+# SPDX-License-Identifier: Apache-2.0
+# SPDX-FileCopyrightText: Copyright contributors to the vLLM project
+"""End-to-end test for the ``vllm bench mm-processor`` CLI.
+
+Most other bench subcommands have a subprocess smoke test in this directory.
+This file covers mm-processor, including the per-stage stats its JSON output
+reports.
+"""
+
+import json
+import math
+import subprocess
+
+import pytest
+
+MODEL_NAME = "Qwen/Qwen2-VL-2B-Instruct"
+NUM_PROMPTS = 3
+
+
+@pytest.mark.benchmark
+def test_bench_mm_processor(tmp_path):
+    output_json = tmp_path / "mm_processor.json"
+    command = [
+        "vllm",
+        "bench",
+        "mm-processor",
+        "--model",
+        MODEL_NAME,
+        "--dataset-name",
+        "random-mm",
+        "--num-prompts",
+        str(NUM_PROMPTS),
+        "--random-input-len",
+        "32",
+        "--random-output-len",
+        "1",
+        "--random-mm-base-items-per-request",
+        "1",
+        "--random-mm-num-mm-items-range-ratio",
+        "0",
+        "--random-mm-bucket-config",
+        "{(224, 224, 1): 1.0}",
+        "--random-mm-limit-mm-per-prompt",
+        '{"image": 1}',
+        "--load-format",
+        "dummy",
+        "--enforce-eager",
+        "--disable-tqdm",
+        "--output-json",
+        str(output_json),
+    ]
+    try:
+        result = subprocess.run(command, capture_output=True, text=True, timeout=900)
+    except subprocess.TimeoutExpired as exc:
+        print(exc.stdout or "")
+        print(exc.stderr or "")
+        raise
+    print(result.stdout)
+    print(result.stderr)
+
+    assert result.returncode == 0, (
+        f"Benchmark failed with exit code {result.returncode}: {result.stderr}"
+    )
+
+    payload = json.loads(output_json.read_text())
+    assert payload["config"]["model"] == MODEL_NAME
+    assert payload["completed"] == NUM_PROMPTS
+    assert payload["failed"] == 0
+
+    # The benchmark exists to report per-stage processor timing. A text-only
+    # request would complete without producing any of these stats.
+    stats = payload["mm_processor_stats"]
+    assert "preprocessor_total_ms" in stats
+    assert stats["preprocessor_total_ms"]["mean"] > 0
+    assert all(
+        math.isfinite(value) for stage in stats.values() for value in stage.values()
+    )
+
+    # The vision encoder must actually have run for these image requests.
+    encoder_summary = payload["encoder_summary"]
+    assert encoder_summary, "no encoder timing recorded"
+    assert encoder_summary["num_requests_with_encoder_calls"] == NUM_PROMPTS
